summary: Accepted Pass A three-view reference sheet for the Identity Emporium Shopkeeper. The sheet presents the shopkeeper in three counter poses: reviewing a mission route card, handing over an identity kit bag, and standing in a full-body reference pose. The title 'Identity Emporium - Shopkeeper' and the captions 'Route Card Review', 'Identity Kit Handoff', and 'Full-Body Reference' frame the sheet as a provisional character asset for repo canonisation.

composition: Landscape reference-sheet layout with a cream border and dark green double-line frame.
Top title reads 'IDENTITY EMPORIUM - SHOPKEEPER' in a dark green serif typeface, underlined by thin gold rules.
Three equal panels arranged horizontally, each showing a different shopkeeper view against the Identity Emporium interior.
Each panel has a dark green inner background and a cream caption bar below it.
Bottom of the sheet states 'Pass A individual character asset sheet - accepted source views - provisional until repo canonisation'.
The background environment shows green painted wood, hanging garments, hats, shelves, a chef's coat, brass lamps, and a wooden counter with props.
character_design: Older human shopkeeper with a bald crown, high forehead, dark curly hair at the sides and back, thick black moustache, round wire glasses, and a prominent rounded nose.
Warm, curious, slightly amused expression with small eyes behind glasses.
Cream long-sleeved shirt with a dark green bow tie and a burgundy waistcoat.
Yellow/cream measuring tape draped around his neck or shoulder.
Full-body panel shows dark charcoal or brown trousers and dark shop shoes.
Proportions are friendly, slightly rounded, and human rather than Patch-like or robotic.
p1_route_card_review: Left panel: waist-up behind-counter pose, the shopkeeper leans forward and holds a 'MISSION ROUTE CARD' with role icons and labels for Cowboy, Detective, Mechanic, and Chef.
A brass bell, open receipt book, and paper tags sit on the counter.
The panel caption reads 'ROUTE CARD REVIEW'.
p2_identity_kit_handoff: Middle panel: waist-up behind-counter pose, the shopkeeper holds a paper bag labelled 'IDENTITY KIT' with 'CONFIDENCE CRAFTED COURTESY' beneath.
He gestures with the other hand as if explaining or presenting the kit.
Counter props include paper tags, a small tray of items, and a brass bell.
The panel caption reads 'IDENTITY KIT HANDOFF'.
p3_full_body_reference: Right panel: full-body standing pose to the right of the counter, the shopkeeper holds the mission route card.
The full silhouette is visible: cream shirt, burgundy waistcoat, measuring tape, green bow tie, dark trousers, and dark shoes.
props_and_environment: Identity Emporium interior with green painted wood, brass lighting, hanging costumes, hats, and folded garments on shelves.
Counter objects: brass bell, open receipt book, paper tags, string, paper bag, mission route card, banker-style green lamp.
The shop sign 'IDENTITY EMPORIUM' is visible in the rear of the full-body panel.
